root_cause: Debris origin unknown: storm damage to policyholder's car, garage roof, and fence could be caused by policyholder's own tree or direct storm damage (property_damage) or by neighbor's shed debris (liability). Wreckage prevents visual determination on-site. This distinction materially affects coverage and third-party liability exposure.

case_facts.description: storm damage to parked car, garage roof, and fence; possible tree or neighbor's shed material involved
case_facts.damage_locations: parked car, garage roof, fence section
case_facts.debris_origin: unknown; could be policyholder's tree or neighbor's shed; wreckage obscures source

recommended_action: Adjuster must conduct physical investigation to determine debris origin. Obtain neighbor contact information if shed damage is suspected. Photograph debris with scale. Review weather reports and debris patterns to establish likely source. Once origin is established, claim can be routed to property_damage or liability queue as appropriate.
